name: Pattern 8: Material Entity Description
description: Gives a structured description of a material entity such as a device or a material: it is tied to the processes or projects it participates in or is an output of, its realizable aspects (role, disposition, function) hang off bearer_of, agents and a place are attached, and its structural composition is given by part and member relations. Further ICEs carry its identifiers, specifications and other descriptive metadata.
competency_questions: Which project produced a given material or device, and which processes has it taken part in?; Where is a given device kept, and what is it designed to do?; Which parts make up a given device, and which model number and intended setpoint values are recorded for the device itself?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
